BLOCKED (HELPER_MISSING): the RosDriver configuration can express the pinned ROS 2 topic surface but not an acknowledged stop for it. Last gate run 2026-11-05T07:10:24Z, backend fake, report digest sha256:0738112eceada7de23f1ca6f1ac710b4f7cae1dea313572d9f48b41201f280eb: G1 pass, G2 pass, G3 pass, G4 pass, G5 pass, G6 fail G6.ESTOP_FAILED (mhs.safety.estop status failed, MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED, the device reports that its safe state was not reached; the latch stays engaged; retrying in the background), G7 pass, G8 fail (MHS-Sim CL3 not achieved at CL2; failing required test SAFE-028: e-stop receipt is failed with MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED and safe_state_achieved=false), G9 skip G9.NOT_RUN because G6 failed. These two failures are the same concrete blocker, not two independent defects.

WHY THE HELPER CANNOT CONFIRM A STOP: the clone registers no ROS service or action. Its control surface is topic publications: /uav/mode (uav_gazebo/msg/ModeData) is subscribed by TrajectoryNode at src/fdcl_uav/fdcl_uav/trajectory.py:86-90 and by ControlNode at control.py:530-534, and published by GuiNode at gui.py:262 and 394-403; /uav/motors_on (std_msgs/msg/Bool) is subscribed by ControlNode at control.py:537-541 and published by GuiNode at gui.py:263 and 363-391. A false /uav/motors_on value makes ControlNode publish zero force and torque at control.py:245-251; mode 0 or 1 selects zero desired states at trajectory.py:148-155; the Gazebo UavControlPlugin subscribes to /uav/fm (uav.urdf.xacro:65-69, uav_control_plugin.cpp:59-64), applies the stored force and torque, and zeroes them after more than 100 updates without a new message (uav_control_plugin.cpp:68-81 and 137-141). None of these paths returns an acknowledgement, and the Gazebo world keeps stepping. The RosBridge safety_status reports achieved=false for an effectful ROS topic command with no acknowledged stop binding, so the stock e-stop fails SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED; the resource state observes the same topics, it does not prove execution. The SDK's RosDriver accepts only a fixed source-backed stop service or action in safety_bindings.estop/.safe_state, and a topic publication with safe_state=True is refused by the bridge. This package therefore declares no safety_bindings and no safe_state.achieved_by action instead of inventing a stop, a zero-velocity acknowledgement, a node-shutdown stop or a Gazebo service endpoint that the pinned clone does not name. An operator must stop the simulation process or publish the stop command from outside the latched driver path. No physical e-stop exists or is claimed.
